passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Ackergaul: This is not working! These specimens are flawed! Useless!

[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Wilfred: Finally... those horse specimens are gone... just...a...little...more

[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Ackergaul: The reason this isn't working is because the specimens are flawed! I have done nothing wrong!

[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Ackergaul: The specimens were already weak! Already beyond saving!

[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Ackergaul: But maybe...hahaha... I am what is needed!

[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Ackergaul: I... will become the perfect specimen... hahahahaha! An entity entirely removed from the demonic!

[[Line 10]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text:
Wilfred: Wait wait wait wait wait! Don't do it!

[[Line 11]]

passages.name: Line 12
passages.text:
Ackergaul: I will stop you... you WILL NOT get in the way of my work! I will save the people from demonic entities like you!

[[Line 13]]

passages.name: Line 13
passages.text:
Wilfred: Meone!? No no! Meone! You were fine up until this point! Come back I can't fight him alone!

[[Line 14]]

passages.name: Line 15
passages.text:
Wilfred: Huh!? What is that thing!?

[[Line 16]]

passages.name: Line 17
passages.text:
Wilfred: Is this thing... helping me? Wait... it needs more electricity!

[[Line 18]]

passages.name: Line 18
passages.text: Wilfred: But where do I get electricity to!?
